_comment: v1.3 Legion Phase 7.3 - Performance baseline for v1.3.0.
Same shape as tests/benchmarks/baseline_v1.0.json so the
bench_tolerance_test can load either one. bench_tolerance_test
defaults to the v1.0 baseline; set FCEUX11_BENCH_BASELINE to
this file to verify against v1.3 instead.
Each benchmark records: name, rom, frames_per_iter, iterations,
and the median total wall-clock time in milliseconds over 5
iterations, measured on the same machine class.
The 1 percent tolerance gate from v1.3 Legion is the ASPIRATIONAL
target. v1.3-v1.5 shipped 2.5; r54 set 5; r55 (2026-10-03) set 10.
Reason: on this dev box the mixed full-frame bench is clock-context
dominated -- the same binary read 132.9 ms fully warmed, ~145 ms in
a ctest suite, and ~163 ms right after a 33-test suite (+23 percent
overall), while CPU and PPU agree within 2 percent across contexts.
No fixed tolerance is deterministic here, so this test is ADVISORY
on this box: the deterministic local gate is ctest -LE perf. Chase
only large sustained shifts; real regressions on this project have
been >100 percent (the pre-r54 baseline). CI excludes wall-clock
gates entirely (-LE perf; 20+ percent runner noise).
